name: Advanced Data Table
description: A feature-rich data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and export capabilities

properties.label: Data Source
properties.name: dataSource
properties.help: Array of objects to display in the table

properties.label: Columns Configuration
properties.name: columns
properties.help: Array defining column properties: [{key: 'field', label: 'Display Name', sortable: true, type: 'text'}]

properties.label: Items Per Page
properties.name: itemsPerPage
properties.help: Number of items to display per page

properties.label: Selected Items
properties.name: selectedItems
properties.help: Array to store selected items (when selection is enabled)

properties.label: Show Row Numbers
properties.name: showRowNumbers
properties.help: Display row numbers in the first column

properties.label: Compact Mode
properties.name: compactMode
properties.help: Reduce padding for a more compact table

properties.label: Loading State
properties.name: isLoading
properties.help: Show loading spinner when data is being fetched

properties.label: Empty Message
properties.name: emptyMessage
properties.help: Message to display when there's no data

properties.label: CSS Classes
properties.name: cssClasses
properties.help: Additional CSS classes to apply to the widget
